answers.goal: I would love to eventually be able to write, direct and edit my own projects.
answers.drew: Was obsessed with movies my whole life. My older sisters began sneaking me into R-rated comedies as early as 6 and I've wanted to make comedies ever since.
answers.seeking: Really anyone who's as passionate about filmmaking as I am.
answers.inspiration: Sam Esmail, who managed to not only create Mr. Robot and serve as show runner, but directed every single episode in the final two seasons.
